method: Exact elimination of the prescribed log-period second derivative; test the recovered vector against the full augmented Jacobian. Same frozen residual and analytic first derivative.
interpretation: A fine-center derivative is recomputed first; the coarse center is not assumed to remain the exact fine-grid turn. A failed step or mesh test remains failed and is not promoted to a bifurcation type.
scope: Local BVP curvature only. Independent Floquet crossing and branch connectivity remain required.
